title: Inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations with competing singular nonlinearities
summary: We study nonlinear elliptic equations that arise as stationary states of inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations with competing singular nonlinearities. The model involves the Laplacian combined with weighted power-type terms and naturally leads to a variational formulation in a weighted Sobolev space obtained from the intersection of the homogeneous Sobolev space with a weighted Lebesgue space.
